acceptance: The runner invokes the preflight check before dispatching a builder for a task
A missing Claude Code binary triggers exactly one authorized reinstall attempt, then a re-check
A failed reinstall stops the run safely: no builder dispatched, task state unchanged, failure reported clearly
Failed authentication stops the run safely with a clear message and no builder dispatched
An unavailable repository stops the run safely with a clear message and no builder dispatched
Tests cover all five scenarios (successful startup, missing binary, failed reinstall, failed authentication, unavailable repository) via injected probes
No credential values appear in preflight output, test output, or logs
